title: Tell Me a Dream. Tell Me a Dream of Two Bodies.
description: The work focuses on pure visual gesture and the dynamics of movement, depicting two leaping figures entirely liberated from mass, ground, and any gravitational anchor. Displaced from a static spatial framework, they materialize an exuberant energy and a sense of liberation, articulated through a signature palette of contrasting pink and green tones. Here, the jump becomes an act of release from the spatial and societal dictates of stability, visualizing the dream as a realm where stepping out of balance is experienced not as a loss of footing, but as the conquest of freedom in which gravity is transcended through expression, intimacy, and momentum.
